prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
finish, new_flow changes are helpful, delivering 5 wins (+10.7%, +7.0%, +3.6%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 9 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, delivering 6 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%, +1.7%, +2.2%), though 8 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in, reorder is high-risk with 1 win (+12.0%) and 2 severe losses (-7.0%, -7.4%), while sign_in, layout and adoption, redesign failed to yield any wins.
adoption, copy; adoption, layout; sign_in, hint; and home, notification consistently showed no clear effect across iterations.
Single-test kinds (such as adoption, new_flow; adoption, wait_info; choose_path, hint; choose_path, layout; choose_path, reorder; sign_in, copy; and sign_in, new_flow) still have thin evidence and do not form established patterns.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Mode & Command Launchpad Flow: Adds an interactive command launchpad screen at the conclusion of onboarding, letting users practice key pet controls before entering the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple tickets regarding confusion over controlling or talking to pets, and finish step new_flow changes have a high historical win rate (+10.7%, +7.0%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Rendering Engine Stage Status Display: Displays live micro-status updates on the waiting screen as the pet rendering engine compiles assets. (why: The waiting stage has a long mean duration of 2336s, and wait_info modifications on the home step have delivered 6 past wins.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Asset Compilation Live Counter: Adds an asset load tracker and itemized preparation checklist to the waiting screen. (why: Decreases drop-off and perceived wait time during the long home stage, leveraging established wait_info wins.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Tray Launch & Keyboard Controls Screen: Introduces a summary screen showcasing system tray shortcuts and hotkey combos for quick pet summoning. (why: Support receives multiple tickets regarding lost or unresponsive desktop pets post-setup.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Rescue Notice: Displays explicit reassurance on sign-in that signing into an existing account restores previously created pets. (why: 8 support emails (largest theme) cited missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Processing Fidelity Assurance Guide: Displays clear photo resolution and lighting feedback on the upload screen to prevent generation errors. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance results.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Sandbox Flow: Adds an interactive sandbox step at the end of onboarding where users practice pet interactions in a contained window. (why: Finish step new_flow changes have delivered major conversion wins while solving support complaints about controls.)
